$comment: NEW-83: the issue's FILES list ×4 (web lib/attachment-files.ts `issueFileRows`, desktop ui::issue_files `issue_file_rows`, iOS ExpCore AttachmentFiles.issueFileRows, Android domain/AttachmentFiles.kt `issueFileRows`): same cases, same names. An attachment is listed under Files iff it is issue-level (`commentId` null; a comment's rows render in that comment's strip, EXP-554) AND either (a) it is a FILE row (a type that never inlines, or `asFile`, EXP-297/EXP-1247) or (b) it is an inline image/video/audio row that NO text of the issue links: neither the description nor any comment body contains `/api/attachments/<id>` (id compared case-insensitively, relative or absolute url, inside `![]()` or `[]()` alike). So an inline upload nobody embedded (an MCP upload whose markdown was never pasted, an embed deleted from the description) stays reachable instead of vanishing on every client; once a text links it, it leaves Files and renders in place. `texts` = the description plus every comment body (null/empty entries ignored); `rows` keep the caller's order (callers sort oldest first); `files` = the ids listed, in that order.

cases.name: an embedded image is not listed
an unlinked audio upload is listed
a linked audio upload is not listed
an unlinked image and video are listed
a link in a comment body counts
an absolute url and another id case count
an asFile row is listed even when linked
